models.name: hrm_time_tracking_guests
models.description: Temporary guest identities used for anonymous access before registration or login. This table stores the minimal identity anchor for unauthenticated visitors and acts as the parent record for {@link hrm_time_tracking_guest_sessions} without containing session data itself.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the guest identity was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the guest identity was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When the guest identity was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary access sessions for anonymous guests.

This table stores session records that track guest connection context, creation time, and expiration time while the visitor uses the platform before registration or login. Each session belongs to exactly one {@link hrm_time_tracking_guests} record and is used for auditing, session management, and security lifecycle handling.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Owning guest's {@link hrm_time_tracking_guests.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address observed when the guest session was created.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page or request URL associated with the guest session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL associated with the guest session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session expires.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_members
models.description:
Registered member accounts that provide the global authenticated identity for the platform.

This table stores the email/password credential anchor for a person who may belong to multiple organizations. Organization membership, sessions, password recovery, and email verification are managed in separate related tables so the account remains normalized and reusable across the tenant structure.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for login and account identity.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used for authentication and account security.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether the member account is enabled for login and authenticated access.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Most recent successful login timestamp for account activity tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp used when the member account is deactivated or removed.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_member_sessions
models.description:
Stores authenticated member sessions for access token and refresh token lifecycle management.

Each row represents one login session created for a specific member account, together with the connection context needed for auditing and security review. The table is append-oriented and supports session expiration, logout handling, and per-member session history through the {@link hrm_time_tracking_members} relationship.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member account that owns this session. References {@link hrm_time_tracking_members.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address recorded when the session was created or refreshed.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current session entry point or requested URL used during authentication.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer information captured for session context and auditing.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session record was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and is no longer valid.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_member_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens issued for member account recovery.

Each record belongs to exactly one {@link hrm_time_tracking_members.id} and represents a single recovery token lifecycle, including when it expires and whether it has already been consumed. This table is part of the authentication recovery flow and must be handled securely and auditably.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Owning member's {@link hrm_time_tracking_members.id} for this password reset request.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure password reset token used to verify the recovery request.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was successfully used, if it has already been consumed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset token record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset token record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for revoked or removed reset records.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Stores one-time email verification tokens issued to confirm newly registered member accounts.

Each record belongs to a single {@link hrm_time_tracking_members} account and tracks the verification token, its lifecycle, and expiration so the platform can validate newly created accounts securely. The table is append-friendly for repeated verification attempts and preserves history of issued verification records without duplicating member identity data.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member account's {@link hrm_time_tracking_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secret verification token used to confirm ownership of the member email address.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the verification token was issued.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When the verification token becomes invalid and can no longer be used.

plainFields.name: verified_at
plainFields.description: When the member email was successfully verified, if verification has completed.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this verification record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: When this verification record was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_organizations
models.description:
Stores each organization's tenant boundary and organization-level identity, including the core profile and operating context used by all organization-scoped data.

This table is the root record for multi-tenant isolation in the hrm_time_tracking system. It represents a business organization as an independent boundary for employees, projects, time tracking, and governance records. All organization-scoped entities reference this model to preserve data separation and ensure that each tenant's operational data remains isolated.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Organization display name used for tenant identification and user-facing navigation.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional organization profile text describing the business context or internal purpose.

plainFields.name: logo_image_url
plainFields.description: Optional logo image URL used for branding in the application UI.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Default financial currency code used for organization-level monetary values and reporting.

plainFields.name: timezone
plainFields.description: Default timezone used for organization schedules, dates, and time-based reporting.

plainFields.name: fiscal_start_month
plainFields.description: First month of the organization's fiscal year, stored as a numeric month value from 1 to 12.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the organization record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_user_accounts
models.description:
Stores the global authenticated user identity for the platform. A single account can belong to multiple organizations and acts as the shared login anchor across tenant contexts.

This table contains only account-level identity and credential data, keeping personal profile details in {@link hrm_time_tracking_user_profiles} and organization-specific membership data in separate tables. The account may remain active even when organization memberships are added, removed, or when an organization is deleted.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address used for login and account identity. Must be unique across all user accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password used for authentication. The raw password is never stored.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the account was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_user_profiles
models.description:
Stores the shared personal profile for a user account across the platform.

This table keeps global identity and contact information separate from organization-scoped membership, employee, and permission data. A profile belongs to exactly one user account and is reused wherever that account participates in one or more organizations.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_user_account_id
foreignFields.description: Owning user account's {@link hrm_time_tracking_user_accounts.id}. This creates the global 1:1 profile anchor shared across all organizations.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Person's display name shown across the platform.

plainFields.name: avatar_image_url
plainFields.description: Profile image URL used for the user's global identity representation.

plainFields.name: phone_number
plainFields.description: Person's contact phone number used for profile contact details.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for profile retention handling.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_invitations
models.description:
Stores workforce invitations sent to an email address for a specific organization.

An invitation represents a pending or accepted onboarding record that allows an organization to invite a person before or after a user account exists. The record preserves invitation state, supports deferred membership, and can later be linked to the resulting {@link hrm_time_tracking_user_accounts.id} when the invited email signs up.

This table is organization-scoped and acts as an administrative onboarding trail rather than a standalone business entity. It keeps the invitation lifecycle auditable while avoiding duplication of organization or user profile data.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that issued the invitation. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: user_account_id
foreignFields.description: User account created from or matched to this invitation when the invited email becomes a registered member. {@link hrm_time_tracking_user_accounts.id}.

foreignFields.name: invited_by_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member account that created the invitation, when the inviter can be traced to an authenticated organization member. {@link hrm_time_tracking_members.id}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address that was invited to join the organization. This value is used to match a later signup and should be stored in normalized, case-consistent form.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure invitation token used to validate acceptance requests and link the invitation to an onboarding flow.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Invitation lifecycle state such as pending, accepted, expired, revoked, or cancelled.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which the invitation is no longer valid for acceptance.

plainFields.name: accepted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation was accepted and converted into organization membership, if it has been accepted.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation was explicitly revoked by an organization administrator, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the invitation record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion of invitation records, when an invitation is removed from active administration but retained for audit history.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_departments
models.description: Stores organization departments used to organize employees within a tenant boundary. Departments may optionally reference one parent department to support a simple one-level hierarchy, and they are designed so that employee assignments can be cleared if a department is removed without losing employee records.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Owning organization's {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}. This enforces tenant isolation for all department records.

foreignFields.name: parent_department_id
foreignFields.description: Optional parent department's {@link hrm_time_tracking_departments.id} for one-level nesting within the same organization.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Department name within the organization. The name should be unique per organization for clear browsing and assignment.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Additional department notes or purpose text for organization members.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp used to preserve historical organization structure while allowing department removal.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_employees
models.description:
Stores the organization-specific employee membership record linking a user account to an organization, a role, and an optional department. This is the core workforce record used for staffing, access assignment, and organization-scoped employee lifecycle management.

Each record represents one employee membership within a single organization and anchors all employee-centric workflows such as role assignment, department placement, contract history, and time-tracking ownership. The table intentionally stores only the current employee state; historical changes such as contracts and role history are handled in separate tables to preserve normalization and auditability.

This table must always remain isolated by organization and must not contain any cross-tenant data. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_user_accounts.id}, {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles.id}, and {@link hrm_time_tracking_departments.id} define the core relationships for membership, authorization, and placement.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this employee membership record. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: user_account_id
foreignFields.description: Global user account linked to this employee membership. {@link hrm_time_tracking_user_accounts.id}.

foreignFields.name: role_id
foreignFields.description: Current organization-scoped role assigned to this employee. {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles.id}.

foreignFields.name: department_id
foreignFields.description: Optional department placement for this employee within the organization. {@link hrm_time_tracking_departments.id}.

plainFields.name: position_title
plainFields.description: Optional job title or position label used for organization-specific staffing display.

plainFields.name: employment_type
plainFields.description: Employment classification for the employee membership, such as full-time, part-time, contractor, or intern.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current employment state within the organization, such as active or deactivated.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee membership was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee membership was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this employee membership was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_contracts
models.description:
Stores immutable employment contracts for {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees} within an organization.

Each record captures one employment term with its effective period, pay terms, working hours, and optional notes. Contracts are preserved as historical business records, and when a new contract is created for an employee, the previous active contract is closed the day before the new contract begins. This table supports auditability, active-contract lookup, and long-term workforce history.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged employee's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when this contract becomes effective.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Date and time when this contract stops being effective. Null while the contract is active.

plainFields.name: pay_rate
plainFields.description: Contract pay rate amount for the selected pay period.

plainFields.name: pay_period
plainFields.description: Pay period unit for the contract compensation, such as hourly, daily, weekly, or monthly.

plainFields.name: working_hours_per_week
plainFields.description: Expected working hours per week under this contract.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional free-form notes about the employment contract.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp used only if historical preservation requires logical deletion.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_roles
models.description:
Organization-scoped access roles used to assign permissions to employees within a tenant. This table stores built-in roles such as Owner, Manager, and Employee as well as custom roles created by organization owners.

Each role belongs to exactly one {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations} record and is referenced by employee assignment records. Role capabilities are normalized into {@link hrm_time_tracking_role_permissions}, while employee-to-role assignment is handled separately so role history and permission mapping remain independently maintainable.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this role. {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Role name shown inside the organization, such as Owner, Manager, Employee, or a custom role name.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Stable internal role code used to identify built-in roles and support system behavior.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable explanation of the role's purpose and responsibilities.

plainFields.name: is_builtin
plainFields.description: Whether this role is a system-defined built-in role that cannot be deleted like a custom role.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Display order for organization role lists and default role presentation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the role record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time when the role record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Time when the role record was soft deleted, if applicable.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_role_permissions
models.description:
Stores the permission capabilities granted to an organization role.

Each row links one role to one permission so access control can be evaluated from the role assignment layer without duplicating permission definitions. This table is managed indirectly through role administration and serves as the normalized junction between {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles} and the shared permission catalog used by the authorization domain.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_role_id
foreignFields.description: Role that receives this permission grant. {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles.id}.

foreignFields.name: permission_id
foreignFields.description: Granted permission capability. {@link hrm_time_tracking_permissions.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the permission grant row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the permission grant row was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the permission grant row was soft deleted, if ever.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_roles
models.description:
Stores role assignment records for employees within an organization, including the effective period of each assignment. This table preserves historical role changes so the system can determine both the current role and the full assignment history for {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees} and {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles}.

Each row represents one assignment period rather than a mutable role field on the employee record. That structure supports role changes over time, preserves administrative history, and keeps the employee-to-role relationship normalized.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee receiving the role assignment. References {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_role_id
foreignFields.description: Role assigned to the employee. References {@link hrm_time_tracking_roles.id}.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this role assignment becomes effective.

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this role assignment ends. Null means the assignment is currently active.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for assignment records that should no longer be active while preserving history.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_projects
models.description:
Projects owned by an organization, including status, schedule, budget, and display metadata used for browsing and lifecycle management.

A project is the core work container for delivery planning inside one organization. It stores the project identity, visual presentation, lifecycle state, and schedule/budget metadata while keeping employee assignment in the separate {@link hrm_time_tracking_project_memberships} table.

The table enforces tenant isolation through the organization reference and supports project browsing, filtering, and lifecycle operations such as active, archived, and completed states. Deletion is soft by default through deleted_at, while hard deletion rules are enforced by application logic when related time entries still exist.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this project. References {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable project name shown in lists and detail views.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional project summary or scope notes.

plainFields.name: color_code
plainFields.description: Required display color used to visually identify the project in UI lists, calendars, and dashboards.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle state of the project. Expected values are active, archived, and completed.

plainFields.name: budget_hours
plainFields.description: Optional planned budget in hours used for progress and capacity reporting.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional project start date used for scheduling and timeline views.

plainFields.name: end_date
plainFields.description: Optional project end date used for scheduling and completion tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the project was soft deleted. Null while active.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_memberships
models.description:
Employee-to-project assignment records that connect one employee to one project and indicate whether the member is a regular participant or a project lead.

This table is the normalized junction between {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees} and {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects}. It supports assigning an employee to multiple projects while preserving a single membership row per project-employee pair. The membership role is stored here because it depends on the specific project relationship, not on the employee or project alone.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_id
foreignFields.description: Project that this membership belongs to. References {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Employee assigned to the project. References {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

plainFields.name: is_project_lead
plainFields.description: Whether this employee has project-lead authority within the project membership.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the membership record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the membership record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the membership was soft-deleted, if it has been removed.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_tasks
models.description:
Work items that belong to a project and track delivery progress within the project execution workflow.

This table stores the current state of each task, including its project ownership, optional assignee, one-level parent hierarchy, status, priority, estimate, and due date. Task status transitions are audited in {@link hrm_time_tracking_task_histories}, while this table remains the authoritative source for the task's present state.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_id
foreignFields.description: Owning project's {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}. Every task belongs to exactly one project and inherits organization isolation through that project.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned employee's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}. The assignee must be a member of the same project, and this assignment is optional.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent task's {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}. Used for one-level task nesting only; deeper recursive hierarchies are not permitted.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Task title used for identification in project lists and task boards.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed task description and execution notes.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current task workflow state such as open, in-progress, completed, or closed.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Task urgency level used for scheduling and prioritization.

plainFields.name: estimated_hours
plainFields.description: Estimated effort in hours for planning and workload forecasting.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Planned deadline for completing the task.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the task record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. A value indicates the task has been archived/deleted without physically removing history.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_histories
models.description:
Immutable audit records that capture each change in a task's status.

Each row stores the task that changed, the previous status, the new status, the moment the change occurred, and the member who performed the change. This table preserves task state history for traceability, reporting, and audit review and is intended to be append-only.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_id
foreignFields.description: The task whose status changed. {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_member_id
foreignFields.description: The member who performed the status change. {@link hrm_time_tracking_members.id}.

plainFields.name: from_status
plainFields.description: The task status before the change was applied.

plainFields.name: to_status
plainFields.description: The task status after the change was applied.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when the status transition occurred.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_timelogs
models.description:
Finalized employee time entries recorded within an organization.

This table stores the raw work log facts needed for manual time entry, timer conversion, weekly reporting, and timesheet approval workflows. Each record belongs to one organization and one employee, references the project worked on, may optionally reference a task in that project, and keeps only atomic business data so the same time entry can be reused in reporting, approval, and audit processes. Inclusion in a timesheet is tracked through {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_timelogs} rather than by duplicating timesheet state here.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged organization's {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Owning employee's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}.

foreignFields.name: project_id
foreignFields.description: Worked project's {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id}.

foreignFields.name: task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task's {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id} when the time entry is tied to a specific task.

plainFields.name: work_date
plainFields.description: Date and time context for when the work was performed, used for daily and weekly reporting.

plainFields.name: duration_minutes
plainFields.description: Measured work duration in minutes for the time entry.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable note describing the work performed.

plainFields.name: billable
plainFields.description: Whether the time entry should be treated as billable time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for removing a timelog while preserving auditability when allowed by business rules.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_timesheets
models.description:
Weekly timesheet records for one employee within one organization. Each record represents a Monday-through-Sunday time collection that can be drafted, submitted, approved, or rejected, and stores the workflow metadata needed for review and auditability.

The actual timelog membership is stored in the separate {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_timelogs} junction table, so this table remains normalized and focused on the timesheet header, state, and review information. Approved and rejected outcomes are preserved through timestamps, reviewer reference, and rejection reason while the included work entries remain independently managed in {@link hrm_time_tracking_timelogs}.

foreignFields.name: organization_id
foreignFields.description: Owning organization's {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}. Ensures tenant isolation for the timesheet record.

foreignFields.name: employee_id
foreignFields.description: Owning employee's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}. Identifies whose weekly time collection this record belongs to.

foreignFields.name: reviewed_by_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Reviewer employee's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id}. Stores who approved or rejected the timesheet when a review decision exists.

plainFields.name: week_start
plainFields.description: The Monday date that starts the week covered by this timesheet.

plainFields.name: week_end
plainFields.description: The Sunday date that ends the week covered by this timesheet.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current workflow state of the timesheet. Expected values are draft, submitted, approved, or rejected.

plainFields.name: submitted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the employee submitted the timesheet for review.

plainFields.name: reviewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timesheet was reviewed and an approval or rejection decision was made.

plainFields.name: rejection_reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided when the timesheet is rejected. Required for rejected state and otherwise nullable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp used to retain historical timesheet records when logically removed.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_timesheet_timelogs
models.description:
Join records that associate one finalized timelog with one timesheet so the system can track weekly inclusion, locking, and review history without duplicating time-entry data.

This table exists only to preserve the relationship between {@link hrm_time_tracking_timelogs} and {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheets}. It supports the rule that a timelog can be included in at most one timesheet at a time, while also keeping the inclusion record auditable through creation and soft-deletion timestamps.

foreignFields.name: timelog_id
foreignFields.description: Included timelog's {@link hrm_time_tracking_timelogs.id}. Each row points to exactly one time entry that is being grouped into a timesheet.

foreignFields.name: timesheet_id
foreignFields.description: Parent timesheet's {@link hrm_time_tracking_timesheets.id}. This identifies the weekly submission that includes the linked timelog.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timelog was linked to the timesheet.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inclusion record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inclusion record was soft-deleted, preserving historical inclusion history.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_timer_sessions
models.description:
Running live timer sessions for in-progress work within an organization.

This table stores the current timer state for a single employee, including the selected project, an optional task within that project, the start timestamp, and an editable description while the timer is running. When the timer stops, the operational workflow may convert the running session into a finalized timelog, but that historical entry is stored elsewhere.

A given employee may have at most one active timer session at a time. The record is intentionally lightweight and supports direct user interaction for starting, editing, stopping, or discarding the live session.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_employee_id
foreignFields.description: Owning employee's {@link hrm_time_tracking_employees.id} for whom this timer session is running.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_project_id
foreignFields.description: Selected project's {@link hrm_time_tracking_projects.id} for the work currently tracked by this timer session.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_task_id
foreignFields.description: Optional task's {@link hrm_time_tracking_tasks.id} when the running work is assigned to a specific task within the selected project.

plainFields.name: started_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the live timer session started.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Editable work description entered while the timer is running.

plainFields.name: ended_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer session stopped and was finalized or otherwise closed.

plainFields.name: discarded_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the timer session was discarded without creating a timelog.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for administrative or recovery purposes.

models.name: hrm_time_tracking_activity_records
models.description:
Append-only organization activity log entries capturing significant business actions, the acting user, target entity metadata, and structured details for auditing and visibility.

Each record belongs to exactly one organization and may optionally record the member who performed the action. The table stores only atomic values so that important events can be queried by organization, actor, target entity, and time without denormalized or JSON-based storage.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_organization_id
foreignFields.description: Organization that owns this activity record. References {@link hrm_time_tracking_organizations.id}.

foreignFields.name: hrm_time_tracking_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who performed the recorded action, when the actor is a signed-in member. References {@link hrm_time_tracking_members.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of business action that occurred, such as employee invited, contract created, project archived, task status changed, or timesheet approved.

plainFields.name: target_entity_type
plainFields.description: Logical type of the affected entity, such as employee, contract, project, task, timesheet, or role assignment.

plainFields.name: target_entity_id
plainFields.description: Identifier of the affected target entity when the action concerns a specific record. Stored as a UUID for atomic lookup and correlation.

plainFields.name: target_entity_label
plainFields.description: Human-readable label or code for the affected entity at the time of the action, when useful for audit readability.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Structured activity payload stored as a compact textual summary of the business event and its important attributes, suitable for audit review without requiring additional state reconstruction.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the activity record was created.
